methodology.confidence: Confirmed facts are separated from provisional study recommendations. No future-question prediction is made.

The official final answer key is dated 17 December 2025; the hub has 91 of 150 questions transcribed and checked.

weeklyPlan.basis: A practical two-hour study day, six days per week; adjust when an official notification is released.

commonCore.task: Learn one syllabus-mapped concept or chapter and make short notes.
Attempt topic-wise MCQs and read every explanation, including why distractors are wrong.
Practise arithmetic/reasoning or the relevant technical/tax topic.
Revise current affairs and Meghalaya facts using dated sources.
Recall previous mistakes and update the wrong-question list.
